  • Option B: Thu 26 Jan, 09:00–10:30 ET

Attached: POC_Success_Criteria_v1.docx and Network_Checklist.xlsx — these are drafts so we can finalize owners during kickoff.

Proposed Redwood attendees: Alex (AE), Dylan (SE), Dev (Solutions).

If procurement/security need a separate slot, please share availability for a 30–45 minute call the same week.

Action items: please reply with preferred option + names/emails for Eng/Procurement/Security owners. Once we have that I’ll send calendar invites and an updated success-criteria doc.

Thanks,
